messages:
sylvia-csm: Heads up — post-incident plan for affected onboarding cohorts. Want to offer a short, hands-on enablement package + account credits to reduce renewal risk and capture feedback. Draft below. Please review ops + messaging and confirm times for office hours.

maria-cs: Love it. Can we make the workshop 45m instead of 60m? Customers prefer short blocks. Also add an FAQ line about data retention during the outage.

sylvia-csm: Good call. Change to 45m and add FAQ bullet. Will add a short follow-up checklist for self-serve remediation.

eli-ml: From ML side — add a short note about embedding reindex safety steps. Some customers will want to know if they should re-ingest. Suggest: "do not reindex unless you see X or Y".

natasha-csm: I'll pull the list of impacted accounts and segment by renewal window (<90d, 90-180d, >180d). We should prioritize <90d for live 1:1s.

maria-cs: Can we include a calendar link with 3x weekly slots for the workshops + 1:1 escalation slots for high-risk accounts?

sylvia-csm: Yes — proposed cadence: 3 workshop slots M/W/F 14:00 PT (45m), plus two 30m 1:1s Tue/Thu morning for <90d renewals. Draft email below (feel free to edit).

sylvia-csm (draft): ```Subject: Update: Incident summary + offer of enablement workshop and account support

Hi <Customer name>,

We wanted to follow up about the weekend incident that affected onboarding and embeddings for a subset of accounts. Our team has completed the primary mitigation and an RCA is in progress.

We are offering a complimentary, short enablement session (45m) to walk through:
  - What happened and immediate impact assessment for your tenant
  - Recommended steps to verify indexing/embedding integrity
  - Live Q&A and remediation checklist you can run today

If your renewal is coming up we also offer a 1:1 remediation call and a goodwill platform credit. You can pick a slot here: <calendar_link>

FAQ highlight: we do not recommend reindexing unless you see missing vectors or mismatched search results. Our support team can advise on a case-by-case basis.

Thanks for your patience — we want to make this right.
Best,
Sylvia on behalf of Customer Success
```

todd-eng: Draft looks good. Suggest adding a short bold line at the top: "No action required for most customers" — reduces panic. Also include contact path for urgent cases (support escalation + account rep).

eli-ml: Also include a tiny diagnostic command snippet customers can paste to check vector counts (example):
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" 
  -d '{"query":"count_vectors","index":"<index>"}' 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/check
```

maria-cs: Putting the calendar link in, and updating the subject to include "complimentary". Also adding a line offering recorded workshop for customers who can't attend.

sylvia-csm: Updated draft attached to email thread. natasha — can you push the segmented list to me by EOD so we can start scheduling invites tomorrow?

natasha-csm: On it. I'll also flag top 10 renewal-risk accounts for prioritization and attach suggested credit amounts based on usage.

deploy-bot: New support ticket created for "Post-incident enablement request" (ticket #INC-2024-5923). Assigned to customer-success.

maria-cs: Action items: 1) sylvia to finalize customer email template and calendar link; 2) natasha to deliver segmented list and top 10; 3) todd/eli to sign off on diagnostic snippets; 4) cs reps to start invites for <90d cohorts. I'll draft the internal playbook (checklist + escalation path).

sylvia-csm: Thanks team — aiming to send first batch by 09:00 PT tomorrow. If anyone can't make the timeline, please flag now.

eli-ml: I can sign off by tonight.

todd-eng: I'll verify the API diagnostic endpoint and confirm by 22:00 PT.

natasha-csm: Delivering list by 20:30 PT.

maria-cs: I'll publish the internal playbook draft in the CS repo and ping this thread when ready. :thumbsup:

sylvia-csm: Perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll capture post-workshop feedback with a 2-question survey: (1) Did the session resolve your primary concern? (yes/no); (2) Any remaining asks? Short survey improves response rate.

maria-cs: Agreed. Also include NPS-style optional feedback for high-touch accounts.

sylvia-csm: Noted. Closing out — planning to send initial emails and invite links, then run workshops next week. Will post postmortem + credit details in a follow-up thread.
